faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: What types of tasks can a virtual assistant handle?
faq.answer1: Our VAs handle a wide range of tasks including administrative work, customer service, scheduling, email management, data entry, social media, e-commerce support, and much more.
faq.question2: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faq.answer2: Absolutely! We offer flexible plans that can be adjusted based on your changing needs. You can scale up or down at any time.
faq.question3: How do you ensure quality and security?
faq.answer3: All our VAs undergo rigorous vetting and training. We use secure communication channels and sign NDAs to protect your sensitive information.
faq.question4: What if I need specialized skills?
faq.answer4: We have VAs with specialized skills across various industries and functions. During our discovery call, we'll match you with the best fit for your specific needs.
